name: Jane Austen
hook: Six novels, one Hampshire village, and the sharpest marriage plots in English fiction.

facts.label: six novels
facts.statement: Austen completed six novels; Sense and Sensibility (1811) was the first published, and Persuasion, her last, appeared posthumously.

facts.label: Pride and Prejudice
facts.statement: Pride and Prejudice follows Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy; it was first drafted as 'First Impressions' and became a zombie novel in 2009.

facts.label: Emma
facts.statement: Emma is about a rich, clever young woman who meddles in other people's matches; 'handsome, clever, and rich' is the famous description of her.

facts.label: Northanger Abbey
facts.statement: Northanger Abbey satirizes the Gothic novel; Catherine Morland imagines the title house is full of terrors.

facts.label: Persuasion
facts.statement: In Persuasion, Anne Elliot is persuaded to refuse Frederick Wentworth; it was the last novel Austen completed.

facts.label: Mansfield Park
facts.statement: Fanny Price is adopted into the family of her rich uncle, who lives at the title estate, Mansfield Park.

facts.label: Sense and Sensibility
facts.statement: The Dashwood family of Sussex opens Sense and Sensibility; Emma Thompson won an Oscar for its screenplay.
